defaults.institution: NASA/STScI publishes these NIRSpec modeling/ETC reference tables; source authorship is recorded per FITS header.
defaults.source_kind: Nominal dispersion-derived resolving power; ground/modeling reference, not an empirical in-flight LSF
defaults.source_definition: R=lambda/delta_lambda with delta_lambda=2.2*DLDS for a 2.2-pixel spectral resolution element. STScI describes a typically fully illuminated IFU/MOS/200 mas fixed-slit aperture.
defaults.input_columns: FITS binary table extension 1: WAVELENGTH [MICRONS], DLDS [MICRONS/PIXEL], R [RESOLUTION; dimensionless]
defaults.processing: Copy all WAVELENGTH and R rows in order; promote source float32 to float64; write CSV wavelength_um,resolving_power with %.17g. No fitting, thinning, interpolation, or recomputation of R during conversion.
defaults.version_caveat: No formal release version is stated for these attachments. Identify bytes by SHA-256; FITS DATE is a creation timestamp, not the latest revision. Attachment version 1 is not a calibration release.
defaults.redistribution_basis: STScI site policy permits public-domain-like use unless otherwise stated and requests NASA/STScI acknowledgement. No contrary restriction was found on the source page or in the seven FITS headers; this is not a separate dataset-specific license grant.
defaults.coverage_table: Table 1; approximate S1600A1 regular-subarray limits; intervals transcribed separately in profiles.toml

SUB2048.selection: Full nominal band except detector gap

SUB1024A.selection: Blue on NRS1, red on NRS2; PRISM/CLEAR unavailable

SUB1024B.selection: Red on NRS1, blue on NRS2

SUB512.selection: Same Table 1 wavelength intervals as SUB512S; PRISM recommended, gratings partially covered

SUB512S.selection: Same Table 1 wavelength intervals as SUB512; no unilluminated spatial pixels in trace

defaults.subarray_resolution_assumption: Reuse the same nominal 2.2-pixel disperser prescription for every subarray; no geometry-based R correction or spatial extraction model
defaults.coverage_limitation: Nominal intervals, not observation-specific detector/extraction limits; consult ETC. Unread subarray regions can exceed the physical detector gap. Medium gratings and PRISM fall on NRS1; high gratings can span NRS1/NRS2.
